home.title: Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua - The Kingdom of God
home.body_md:
## What If Everything You Were Taught About Christianity Was Missing the Most Important Part?

Jesus mentioned the Kingdom of God **53 times**. He mentioned "church" **twice**.

There's a reason for that - and it changes everything.

---

I'm **Kahu Phil Stephens** - a pastor, Paniolo, and 30-year student of Scripture in the original Greek and Hebrew, writing to you from Moloka'i, Hawai'i.

After three decades of study, I made a discovery that turned my faith upside down - in the best way. Jesus didn't come to start a religion. He came to establish a **Kingdom**. And that Kingdom has three dimensions that touch every part of your life.

---

### The Three Pillars of Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua

**The Kingdom of God** - Rediscover what Jesus actually preached. Not church. Not religion. The revolutionary Kingdom message that transforms your mind, your identity, and your purpose.

**[Explore the Kingdom Series](/call_to_repentance)**

---

**Kingdom Wellness** - Your body is not a burden. It is a temple - and the Kingdom has a design for it. Discover how a Paniolo pastor from Moloka'i lost 54 pounds without dieting, through a revelation rooted in Scripture and confirmed by a life on horseback.

**[Discover Aloha Wellness](/aloha_wellness)**

---

**Kingdom Wealth** - The Kingdom operates on stewardship, not ownership. Learn the biblical principles of increase that most churches never teach.

**[Learn Kingdom Wealth](/kingdom_wealth)**

---

**Kingdom Study Tools** - Go deeper into Scripture with 73 original Hebrew and Greek word studies built for Kingdom theology. Unlock the living meaning behind the words of Jesus.

**[Explore Kingdom Study Tools](/kingdom-study)**

---

### Start Here - FREE

Not sure where to begin? Start with our **FREE Kingdom Keys** - short, powerful booklets drawn from 30 years of studying Scripture in the original Greek and Hebrew.

**[Get Your FREE Kingdom Keys](/kingdom_keys)**

*Aloha. You are in the right place.*

pastor_planners.title: Pastor Planners - Tools for Ministry Excellence
pastor_planners.body_md:
## Organize Your Ministry with Purpose and Prayer

Built for pastors who serve Pacific Islander and multilingual communities - these planners combine daily prayer, sermon preparation, pastoral care tracking, and ministry administration into one beautifully designed tool.

Created by **Kahu Phil Stephens** - pastor, teacher, and 30-year student of Scripture in the original Greek and Hebrew - these planners reflect the values of Kingdom ministry: intentionality, prayer, and faithful stewardship of the calling God has placed on your life.

---

### Why a Pastor Needs More Than a Calendar

Ministry is not a job. It is a Kingdom assignment. And like any assignment of eternal significance, it requires more than good intentions - it requires structure, prayer, and daily accountability before God.

Most planners are designed for business people. They are built around productivity, efficiency, and output. But the pastor’s calling is different. A pastor must track souls, not just schedules. A pastor must steward relationships, prayer, study, and community - not just meetings and deadlines.

These planners were built from the ground up for that kind of ministry. Every section reflects the rhythm of a Kingdom life: prayer first, then planning. Scripture before strategy. People before programs.

---

### Rooted in Pacific Islander Culture

The Hawaiian and Samoan editions are not translations of a generic planner. They are original works that honor the language, values, and cultural identity of Pacific Islander ministry leaders.

In Hawaiian culture, **kuleana** - responsibility and privilege - is the foundation of leadership. In Samoan culture, **faʻaasamoa** - the Samoan way - shapes how community and ministry flow together. These planners honor both.

For pastors who serve in these languages and cultures, having a ministry tool that speaks their language - literally - is a statement of dignity and purpose.

---

### Available Editions

**Ke Kauoha La Haku - Hawaiian Edition 2026**
The first pastoral planner designed specifically for Hawaiian-speaking ministers. Bilingual Hawaiian/English format with Hawaiian cultural values woven throughout.

[Get on Amazon](https://a.co/d/gatnNET) | [Get on Gumroad](https://uncomango.gumroad.com/l/ulrmu)

---

**Tusi Fuataiaga a le Faifeau - Samoan Enhanced Edition 2026**
Designed for Samoan-speaking pastors and ministry leaders. Enhanced format with expanded planning sections and Samoan language throughout.

[Get on Amazon](https://a.co/d/gs0WRPh) | [Get on Gumroad](https://uncomango.gumroad.com/l/ubzevn)

---

### What Makes These Planners Different

- Designed by a working pastor who understands the daily demands of ministry
- Native language editions that honor cultural identity
- Integrates prayer, planning, and pastoral care in one place
- Kingdom-centered framework - not just time management, but stewardship of calling
- Professional quality suitable for gift-giving and ministry partnerships

---

### A Word from Kahu Phil

I have been a pastor on Molokaʻi for eight years. Before that, thirty years of ranching, thirty years of studying Scripture, and a lifetime of living in Hawaiian culture. I built these planners because I needed them and they did not exist.

If you are a pastor serving a Pacific Islander congregation - or any congregation where the mainstream Christian publishing world has never thought to serve you - these planners are for you.

*More language editions coming: Tongan, Fijian, Filipino, Japanese, and more.*

*Published by Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua Press, Molokaʻi, Hawaiʻi.*

free_booklets.title: FREE Booklets
free_booklets.body_md:
## FREE Kingdom Booklets - Yours as a Gift

These booklets are drawn from **30 years of biblical study** in the original Greek and Hebrew - and they are completely free.

Kahu Phil Stephens has spent three decades studying the Kingdom of God as Jesus actually taught it - not through the lens of religious tradition, but through the original language of Scripture. These booklets represent the distilled essence of that study. Practical. Powerful. Grounded in the Word.

**Download all 6 booklets below** - no email required, no strings attached. This is Kingdom generosity in action.

---

### What Is Kingdom Theology?

Jesus used the phrase “Kingdom of God” 53 times in the Gospels. He used the word “church” twice. That ratio is not an accident. Jesus came to establish a Kingdom - a complete system of governance, identity, wealth, wellness, and purpose that covers every dimension of human life.

Most believers have been taught a church-centered gospel. These booklets introduce you to the Kingdom-centered gospel that Jesus actually preached. The difference will change how you read Scripture, how you approach money, how you steward your body, and how you understand your purpose on earth.

---

### The Six Booklets

Each booklet focuses on one dimension of Kingdom life. Together they form a foundation for understanding what it means to live as a citizen of Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua - the Kingdom of God.

**Kingdom Wealth Principles** - The biblical foundations of increase, stewardship, and generosity. What the Kingdom says about money that most churches never teach.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet1)

---

**Kingdom Wealth for Couples** - How husbands and wives can align around Kingdom financial principles. Unity in stewardship as a spiritual discipline.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet2)

---

**Kingdom Wellness Principles** - Your body is a temple, not a burden. The Kingdom framework for health, eating, and physical stewardship rooted in Scripture.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet3)

---

**Kingdom Wellness for Couples** - How couples can pursue health together as an act of Kingdom faithfulness. Practical and Scripture-grounded.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet4)

---

**Kingdom Living Principles** - Identity, purpose, and daily life as a Kingdom citizen. Who you are in the Kingdom determines how you live in the world.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet5)

---

**Kingdom Living for Couples** - Marriage as a Kingdom institution. How two people can build a household that reflects the values and purposes of the Kingdom of God.

[FREE Download](https://keaupuniakeakua.faith/download/booklet6)

---

### Why Free?

The Kingdom of God operates on a principle of seed and harvest. These booklets are seed. Kahu Phil offers them freely because he believes that what God has given him belongs to the Body of Christ - not to a publishing program.

If these booklets change your life, you are welcome to give. But there is no obligation. The Kingdom does not put a price on truth.

*Written and published from Molokaʻi, Hawaiʻi by Ke Aupuni O Ke Akua Press.*
